tables.name: _Measures
tables.description:
Home table for all measures, grouped in display folders.
Combine any measure with the 'Time Intelligence' calculation group for MTD, YTD, PY and YoY.

measures.name: Net Revenue
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[Net Amount] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)
measures.description: Revenue after discounts, VAT excluded, of delivered and shipped orders.

measures.name: Gross Revenue
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[Gross Amount] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)

measures.name: Discounts
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[Discount Amount] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)

measures.name: Units
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)

measures.name: Orders
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[Order ID] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)

measures.name: Gross Margin
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[Margin Amount] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)
measures.description: Net revenue minus cost of goods sold.

measures.name: Active Customers
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[Customer ID] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Is Revenue] = TRUE () )
)
measures.description: Customers with at least one revenue order in the selected period.

measures.name: New Customers
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( Customers ),
    TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'Date'[Date] ), Customers[First Order Date] )
)
measures.description: Customers whose first revenue order falls in the selected period.

partitions.name: _Measures
partitions.source:
let
    Source = #table(type table [Placeholder = Int64.Type], {})
in
    Source

tables.name: Sales
tables.description: Sales fact at order-line grain (marts.fct_sales). Numeric columns are hidden: use the measures.

columns.name: Channel
columns.description: Sales channel: web, app or marketplace.

columns.name: Is Revenue
columns.description: TRUE for delivered and shipped orders. Revenue measures filter on it.

partitions.name: Sales
partitions.source:
let
    Source = LoadMart("fct_sales"),
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Source, {
        "order_item_id", "order_id", "order_date", "customer_id", "product_id",
        "channel", "payment_method", "status", "is_revenue", "quantity",
        "gross_amount", "discount_amount", "net_amount", "cost_amount", "margin_amount"
    }),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Selected, {
        {"order_item_id", Int64.Type}, {"order_id", Int64.Type}, {"order_date", type date},
        {"customer_id", Int64.Type}, {"product_id", Int64.Type},
        {"channel", type text}, {"payment_method", type text}, {"status", type text},
        {"is_revenue", type logical}, {"quantity", Int64.Type},
        {"gross_amount", Currency.Type}, {"discount_amount", Currency.Type},
        {"net_amount", Currency.Type}, {"cost_amount", Currency.Type},
        {"margin_amount", Currency.Type}
    }, "en-US")
in
    Typed

tables.name: Customers
tables.description: Customer dimension (marts.dim_customers). Row-level security filters this table by region.

columns.name: First Order Date
columns.description: Date of the first revenue order. Used by the New Customers measure.

columns.name: Segment Order
columns.description:
Sort order of Segment. Calculated in Power Query: a DAX calculated column based on
Segment would create a circular dependency with the sort-by-column setting.

partitions.name: Customers
partitions.source:
let
    Source = LoadMart("dim_customers"),
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Source, {
        "customer_id", "full_name", "city", "region", "country",
        "signup_date", "first_order_date", "last_order_date", "customer_segment"
    }),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Selected, {
        {"customer_id", Int64.Type}, {"full_name", type text}, {"city", type text},
        {"region", type text}, {"country", type text}, {"signup_date", type date},
        {"first_order_date", type date}, {"last_order_date", type date},
        {"customer_segment", type text}
    }, "en-US"),
    WithOrder = Table.AddColumn(Typed, "segment_order",
        each List.PositionOf({"new", "occasional", "regular", "vip"}, [customer_segment]) + 1,
        Int64.Type)
in
    WithOrder

columns.name: Unit Price
columns.description: Current list price per unit (EUR, VAT excluded).

columns.name: Price Band Order
columns.description: Sort order of Price Band, calculated in Power Query (see Customers[Segment Order]).

partitions.name: Products

tables.name: Date
tables.description: Calendar (marts.dim_date), marked as the date table of the model.

columns.name: Year Month
columns.description: Year and month as text (2025-01), sorts chronologically.

columns.name: Date With Sales
columns.description:
TRUE up to the last order date. Time-intelligence items shift only these dates, so
future years of the calendar do not show a previous-year value without current sales.

partitions.name: Date

tables.name: Time Intelligence
tables.description: Calculation group: applies the selected time calculation to ANY measure of the model.

calculation_items.name: PY
calculation_items.expression: CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ), 'Date'[Date With Sales] = TRUE ) )

calculation_items.name: YoY
calculation_items.expression:
VAR CurrentValue = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
VAR PreviousValue =
    CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ), 'Date'[Date With Sales] = TRUE ) )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( CurrentValue ) && NOT ISBLANK ( PreviousValue ), CurrentValue - PreviousValue )

calculation_items.name: YoY %
calculation_items.expression:
VAR CurrentValue = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
VAR PreviousValue =
    CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ), 'Date'[Date With Sales] = TRUE ) )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( CurrentValue ), DIVIDE ( CurrentValue - PreviousValue, PreviousValue ) )

tables.name: Security
tables.description:
Mapping user -> regions for dynamic row-level security (role 'Regional Manager').
Demo data inline; in production this table would come from the identity source.

partitions.name: Security

roles.name: Regional Manager
roles.description: Dynamic RLS: each manager only sees the customers (and therefore the sales) of their regions.

table_filters.Customers:
Customers[Region]
    IN CALCULATETABLE (
        VALUES ( Security[Region] ),
        Security[User Email] = USERPRINCIPALNAME ()
    )

expressions.name: SourceMode
expressions.description: Where the data comes from: "Sample" (CSV files in this repository) or "BigQuery" (the marts dataset).

expressions.name: SampleDataPath
expressions.expression: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adonaismarrero/powerbi-sales-semantic-model/main/sample-data/" meta [IsParameterQuery = true, IsParameterQueryRequired = true, Type = type text]
expressions.description: Sample mode: base URL (https://...) or local folder (ending in \) with the CSV files.

expressions.name: BigQueryProject
expressions.description: BigQuery mode: GCP project that hosts the marts dataset (also used as billing project).

expressions.name: BigQueryDataset
expressions.description: BigQuery mode: dataset built by Dataform with the star schema.

expressions.name: LoadMart
expressions.expression:
(tableName as text) as table =>
let
    FromCsv = (content as binary) as table =>
        Table.PromoteHeaders(
            Csv.Document(content, [Delimiter = ",", Encoding = 65001, QuoteStyle = QuoteStyle.Csv]),
            [PromoteAllScalars = true]
        ),
    Source =
        if SourceMode = "BigQuery" then
            GoogleBigQuery.Database([BillingProject = BigQueryProject])
                {[Name = BigQueryProject]}[Data]
                {[Name = BigQueryDataset, Kind = "Schema"]}[Data]
                {[Name = tableName, Kind = "Table"]}[Data]
        else if Text.StartsWith(SampleDataPath, "http") then
            FromCsv(Web.Contents(SampleDataPath, [RelativePath = tableName & ".csv"]))
        else
            FromCsv(File.Contents(SampleDataPath & tableName & ".csv"))
in
    Source
expressions.description: Returns a marts table from BigQuery or from the sample CSV files, with the same columns in both modes.
